content.title: Axon’s (NASDAQ:AXON) Q3: Beats On Revenue But Stock Drops 14.1%
content.summary: Self defense company AXON (NASDAQ:AXON) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 30.6% year on year to $710.6 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $752.5 million at the midpoint, 1.3% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.17 per share was 24.1% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.title: Axon: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: The average estimate of seven analysts surveyed by Zacks Investment Research was for earnings of $1.63 per share. The maker of stun guns and body cameras posted revenue of $710.6 million in the period, which beat Street forecasts. Seven analysts surveyed by Zacks expected $699.6 million.
